programme.title: El sol bajo la tierra
programme.desc: Roy escapa de un campo de trabajo y recibe ayuda de un minero. Los mineros son rehenes del jefe local, el Sr. Redfield. Roy empieza a ayudar a los mineros y también a ajustar cuentas con un amigo del campo de trabajo.

programme.title: Alambradas de violencia
programme.desc: Alambradas de violencia - Enviado a Montana para dar caza a unos ladrones de bancos, un cazarrecompensas le quita la estrella a un sheriff sustituto que no llegó a su destino y se mete en una guerra de ranchos entre granjeros y ganaderos.

programme.title: Un hombre y un colt
programme.desc: Dakota Joe - Un pistolero a sueldo decide no llevar a cabo su trabajo de matar a un médico cuando descubre que está trabajando para los pobres de la revolución.

programme.title: ¡Ay, Jalisco no te rajes!
programme.desc: Western clásico de vaqueros hecho en México.

programme.title: Un colt por 4 cirios
programme.desc: Una banda atraca un cargamento fiscal de oro. Esa noche, durante la celebración, Farley roba el oro, pero es encontrado muerto a la mañana siguiente.

programme.title: El gran McLintock
programme.desc: El rico ranchero G.W. McLintock utiliza su poder e influencia en el territorio para mantener la paz entre los agricultores, ganaderos, acaparadores de tierras, indios y funcionarios corruptos del gobierno.

programme.title: Killer calibre 32
programme.desc: El súper genial Silver elimina uno a uno a los siete miembros de una banda enmascarada. Entre chicas de taberna y partidas de póquer, la acción no para hasta el dramático desenmascaramiento del jefe de la banda malvada.

programme.title: Avanzada del Infierno
programme.desc: Un veterano de la guerra de Corea intenta ayudar al propietario de una mina de un pequeño pueblo, a desarrollar su mina de tungsteno a pesar de los esfuerzos del jefe del pueblo por detenerlo.

programme.title: El sureño
programme.desc: Adaptación de la novela "Sostén el otoño en tu mano" - La vida de la pobre familia Tucker, que trabajaba como taponadora de algodón y decidió conseguir su propio terreno, pero la naturaleza está en su contra.

programme.title: Yo Soy Vuestro Verdugo
programme.desc: Yo Soy Vuestro Verdugo - Sartana es falsamente acusado de robar un banco, y debe encontrar a los verdaderos ladrones y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: El secreto del capitán O'Hara
programme.desc: Un soldado sometido a consejo de guerra salva un fuerte y al comandante que testificó falsamente contra él de un ataque indio.

programme.title: Odio por odio
programme.desc: Odio por odio - Un ladrón de bancos que se odia a sí mismo forma una incómoda alianza con un ingenioso buscador de oro mexicano para salvar a su familia de un antiguo socio criminal asesino.

programme.title: Pistoleros de Río Grande
programme.desc: Un vagabundo regresa a un pequeño pueblo para vengar el asesinato de su esposa e hija.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: Abre tu fosa amigo... llega Sábata
programme.desc: Abre tu fosa amigo... llega Sábata - Steve McGowan regresa de la Guerra Civil y descubre que su padre ha sido asesinado por un codicioso terrateniente. McGowan jura vengarse. En el proceso, se enamora de la prometida del terrateniente.

programme.title: Fuerte solitario
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una repentina oleada de asesinatos en la región del Big Bend de Texas, las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre un joven vagabundo que acaba de mudarse a la zona.

programme.title: El día de la ira
programme.desc: Un chico de la basura desaliñado se convierte en el alumno de un famoso pistolero.

programme.title: Su nombre gritaba venganza
programme.desc: Un veterano de la Guerra Civil queda amnésico tras recibir un disparo en la cabeza. Cuando regresa a su ciudad natal, descubre que ha sido declarado desertor.

programme.title: Quedó uno Sólo...La Muerte fue Para Todos
programme.desc: Un hombre es acusado falsamente de robo de banco, incitando a su hermano a sacarlo de la prisión.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill en territorio Tomahawk
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill intenta proteger las tierras de los indios de una banda que quiere hacerse con el oro enterrado allí.

programme.title: Senderos de violencia
programme.desc: Un deshonrado explorador indio y su compañero son contratados para escoltar una carreta de armas a través del territorio indio.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 31, 32, 33
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: Bandidos
programme.desc: El renombrado pistolero Richard Martin viaja en un tren, asaltado por Billy Kane, un antiguo alumno de Martin. Kane perdona a Martin, pero sólo después de dispararle en las manos. Años después, Martin se encuentra con.

programme.title: Tu cabeza por mil dólares
programme.desc: Johnny Forest, cazador de recompensas, intenta cumplir el último deseo de su madre de que traiga vivo a su hermano forajido, Clint.

programme.title: Bajo el cielo de Arizona
programme.desc: Un vaquero escolta a una niña, cuya madre le heredó una rentable compañía petrolífera, y debe protegerla de un forajido mientras buscan al padre de la niña.

programme.title: El tesoro del lago de plata
programme.desc: Tras el asalto a una diligencia y el asesinato de su padre, Fred Engel se une a Old Shatterhand y Winnetou para recuperar un mapa del tesoro dividido en dos. Su búsqueda los lleva hasta Silver Lake, donde deberán adelantarse a la banda del coronel Brinkley, decidida a hacerse con el oro.

programme.title: El retorno de Clint el solitario
programme.desc: Trinity es un ex pistolero que desea desesperadamente ser perdonado y aceptado por su familia, a la que abandonó años atrás.

programme.title: La mujer del látigo
programme.desc: Salvaje Oeste - Para evitar la soga del ahorcado, un vaquero acepta casarse con una bella pero ardiente pelirroja.

programme.title: El sabor de la venganza
programme.desc: El sabor de la venganza - Tres hermanos desiguales buscan venganza por el asesinato de su padre. Cada uno de ellos toma un camino diferente.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Las tres reinas: así es como Mikhail Pogodin, director y propietario de una bodega en la ciudad de Chernomorsk, quería nombrar la marca de su nuevo vino, pero no llegó a hacerlo... Fue encontrado muerto en su piso. Viktor, su hijo, regresa a su ciudad natal y decide investigar la causa de la muerte de su padre y salvar el negocio familiar.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Víctor descubre que su padre trabajaba en un vino especial. Mientras tanto, su madrastra Ella es manipulada por su amante para entregar documentos de la bodega. Todo parece indicar un suicidio, pero Víctor no está convencido.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Un experto revela que la nota de despedida de Pogodin es falsa. Víctor busca a un anciano en las montañas para descubrir el secreto del vino "Tres Reinas". Mientras tanto, el vicealcalde ordena vigilarlo de cerca.

programme.title: Las tres reinas
programme.desc: Ella intenta sobornar a Víctor para que abandone la investigación. Katya consigue los diarios del padre de Víctor. La prometida de Víctor, Zhenya, llega a la ciudad, pero él se da cuenta de que siempre ha amado a Katya.

programme.title: Memorias de lo que no fue
programme.desc: En el sórdido submundo de la vida nocturna de la Ciudad de México, Fernando y Miguel se conocen durante una noche salvaje en un famoso club gay. Lo que comienza como un encuentro casual se transforma en un misterio inquietante cuando Fernando despierta a la mañana siguiente sin recordar quién es ni cómo llegó allí. Sin ningún tipo de identificación y perdido en una niebla de confusión, se encuentra dependiendo de Miguel, quien promete ayudarle a descubrir su pasado olvidado. Mientras navegan por los fragmentos poco fiables de los recuerdos de Fernando, los dos jóvenes se ven arrojados a una relación intensa e inesperada. Su búsqueda de la verdad se vuelve cada vez más peligrosa, revelando oscuros secretos y peligros ocultos que acechan en las sombras de sus pasados. La historia avanza con la aparición de nuevos personajes envueltos en misterio e intriga, empujando a Fernando y Miguel al borde de su cordura. Lo que comienza como una exploración de la amnesia y la identidad se convierte en un thriller impactante, donde la búsqueda de respuestas se encuentra con el derramamiento de sangre y la venganza.

programme.title: Jaque Mate
programme.desc: David Hernández, conocido por ser el presentador del exitoso programa ficticio de juegos "Jaque Mate", se ve repentinamente sumergido en una pesadilla cuando recibe una llamada anónima durante una transmisión en vivo. El desconocido le informa que su hijo y esposa han sido secuestrados y que su vida depende de seguir las instrucciones que le dará en el programa. Aterrorizado y bajo la presión del secuestrador, David se ve obligado a convertir su programa en un escenario para cumplir con las demandas del criminal. Mientras la audiencia mira atónita, David debe resolver acertijos y desafíos en tiempo real para garantizar la seguridad de su familia. La tensión aumenta a medida que cada movimiento en el juego televisivo podría significar la diferencia entre la vida y la muerte para sus seres queridos. Determinado y enfrentando peligros desconocidos, David se embarca en una incansable búsqueda para reunir a su familia sana y salva, desafiando todo lo que le rodea para lograr su objetivo.

programme.title: La vida mancha
programme.desc: El regreso de Pedro altera la vida de su hermano Fito y deja consecuencias inesperadas para ambos.

programme.title: Vida
programme.desc: Dos amigos criados en la pobreza toman caminos opuestos, marcados por una herida de infancia.

programme.title: Antes que cante el gallo
programme.desc: La adolescente Carmín ve desvanecerse su sueño de mudarse a la ciudad junto a su madre Doris, quien decide partir a Estados Unidos con su nuevo esposo. Ahora, Carmín crece y vive en Barranquitas, un pintoresco pueblo montañoso en el centro de Puerto Rico, bajo el cuidado de su abuela, una mujer firme y de convicciones conservadoras. La llegada inesperada de su padre Rubén, después de años en prisión, trae consigo una mezcla de alivio por su presencia y complicaciones por las ambigüedades en su relación. Ahora, Carmín se enfrenta a aprender a vivir entre el abandono y la cautela, mientras navega entre la ausencia, el deseo y el amor. La dinámica familiar se entrelaza con los desafíos de su adolescencia, mientras ella busca entender y reconciliar los sentimientos encontrados que surgen con la reaparición de su padre en su vida.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: A "Best of..." episode spanning the past 4 seasons of Winchester Life.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger. Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors. These are the hunts they'll remember forever.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.
Clay and Crystal Charlton of Take-Em Outfitters are after everything big in Alberta! Giant Lake Trout, Monster Black Bear and Big Muleys!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Hunting has a way of grounding us, reminding us of what truly matters: shared moments and unforgettable memories. Chance and Ashleigh Eckert are on their first out-of-state hunt in the rolling hills of Ohio. After overcoming a life-changing kidney transplant, their story is one of faith, love, and resilience. While the goal was a big buck, the true reward was the time spent together and the lessons learned along the way. Because hunting is about so much more than the harvest — it’s about the journey.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat. Join Mark as he navigates the diverse terrain of the Orange Free State, putting his skills to the test in pursuit of these wary and elusive animals. Navigating the region’s expansive plateaus, Mark must rely on his glassing skills and long-range accuracy to secure these elusive trophies. This film features an 820 Yard Shot with his Gunwerks 300PRC - by far the longest shot Mark has ever done on a live animal! This is a prime testimony for Gunwerks' Long Range University.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in Ethiopia hunting Mountain Nyala. After the first two days, Mark has taken a Menelik’s Bushbuck and a Colobus Monkey but no Mountain Nyala. Finally, on Day 3 the hunting party receives the green light from the military to hunt in the area they wanted. It's time to put the Gunwerks rifle to the test.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don’t miss it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man

Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: hunting_land_man

programme.title: Winchester Life

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Bring a clear intention to your practice today, looking inward to ask: How would I like to take a stand in the world? programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.desc: A young girl taught to be unfazed by death grows up to be a dangerous woman with very peculiar desires.

programme.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
programme.desc: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: She Came Back
programme.desc: The terrifying journey of Charley who, after a near-death experience, is haunted by her relationship with her deceased mother.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: Lilith
programme.desc: A family sequesters themselves in a high-rise apartment after the mysterious death of their daughter Lilith. Haunted by their past, the survivor's lies, deceits and strange behavior will have you asking: who killed Lilith and who will be next?

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: V/H/S 2
programme.desc: Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.

programme.title: Violet & Daisy
programme.desc: Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programme.title: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programme.desc: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programme.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programme.desc: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.

programme.title: The Woman in the Fifth
programme.desc: A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.

programme.title: XX

programme.title: A.I.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: Better Watch Out
programme.desc: On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

programme.title: Come Out and Play
programme.desc: A couple take a vacation to a remote island - their last holiday together before they become parents. Soon after their arrival, they notice that no adults seem to be present - an observation that quickly presents a nightmarish reality.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: After a kidnapping, a secret-agent-turned-mercenary reemerges upon learning the crime hits close to home. However, when an infamous gangster learns just who has entered the country, he goes on a bloody rampage to thwart the rescue mission.

programme.title: Eloise
programme.desc: Four friends break into an insane asylum in search of a certificate which will grant one of them a large inheritance.

programme.title: Heavyweight
programme.desc: A boxing coach prepares an underdog for a career-defining boxing championship match, as their world starts to collapse under the pressure.

programme.title: I Saw the Devil
programme.desc: Soo-hyun is determined to track down the murderer of his late wife even if it means becoming a monster.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Behind every great martial artist lies a teacher. Ip Man, starring Donnie Yen, is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, grandmaster of Wing Chun and mentor to legendary kung fu superstar Bruce Lee. Set in Fo Shan, China during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man vividly brings to life the brutality of the infamous Japanese occupation, where once proud men are forced to fight to the death for a precious bag of rice. Defined by courage and humility, Ip Man, whose fighting skills are revered all over China, rises to the fore front. Upon refusing to teach his martial arts to the invading Japanese soldiers, he is forced to fight for the honor of his country in a series of battles that will culminate in a kill-or-be-killed showdown with Japan’s greatest fighter.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Diana Krall - Live In Rio
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long-time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This stunning concert is filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008.

programme.title: Chic: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Deep Purple - Live in Verona
programme.desc: Filmed in the spectacular surroundings of the Arena di Verona, a Roman amphitheater originally built in 30 AD, this concert from 2011 sees Deep Purple joined on stage by a full symphony orchestra for performances of all their classic tracks.

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track.

programme.title: The Clash - Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one of the greatest frontmen in rock'n'Roll music history.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers - Live at Soundstage

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drag superstar, musician, and TV personality Trixie Mattel joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in small-town Wisconsin, discovering drag, and building a multifaceted career in music, television, and business. They discuss identity, faith, creativity, and the crossover between drag and punk culture — finding connection through authenticity and humor.

programme.title: Get Thrashed: Around the World (Bonus Interviews on Thrash Metal)
programme.desc: Bonus footage from Get Thrashed featuring global thrash scenes—from Germany to Brazil—with members of Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus sharing deep-cut bands and era highlights.

programme.title: Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls: The First Four Albums (2012 Revisited) Live in Anaheim
programme.desc: Night 2 of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim finds Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls tearing through favorites and deep cuts from the first four albums—Sleep Is for the Week, Love Ire & Song, Poetry of the Deed, and England Keep My Bones. A charged, communal set featuring sing-alongs like “Try This at Home,” “Reasons Not to Be an Idiot,” “Nashville Tennessee,” “Peggy Sang the Blues,” “There Is No God,” and “If Ever I Stray/Keep Having Dreams,” captured live at House of Blues Anaheim.

programme.title: Tomorrow: Frost Children
programme.desc: Frost Children star in Episode 2 of TOMORROW!, exploring their creative process in New York City and culminating in a live performance.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: In this surreal premiere, Poppy hits the streets of Monrovia offering eerie fortunes, interviews a survivor of the Dave Matthews Band bus disaster, and encounters Archduke Franz Ferdinand in a time-warping twist. Between absurd sketches and existential reflections, she performs a musical lesson on embracing chaos and taking risks. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Jay Pharoah: Can I Be Me?
programme.desc: Jay Pharoah delivers a stand-up special packed with celebrity impressions and sharp humor, featuring takes on icons like Jay-Z, Barack Obama, and more.

programme.title: Lost Evenings VI: Night 1 – Acoustic Duo with Matt Nasir
programme.desc: The opening night of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim features an intimate acoustic set from Frank Turner and Matt Nasir. The performance blends heartfelt storytelling with stripped-down versions of fan favorites, including “Be More Kind,” “The Way I Tend to Be,” and a moving duet with KT Tunstall. Turner connects deeply with the audience while revisiting early songs and debuting new arrangements in this special evening of community, humor, and reflection.

programme.title: Sarah Barthel on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Sarah Barthel—singer, songwriter, and one half of platinum duo Phantogram—for a candid conversation about using art to process emotion, the band’s obsessive pursuit of a singular sound, and the lifelong creative bond between Sarah and bandmate Josh Carter. They trace Phantogram’s beginnings (from beat tapes to breakthrough), balancing romance and partnership, channeling real-life heartbreak into “When I’m Small,” coping with family loss, and gearing up for a summer tour with Deftones. Cameos of warmth (including Leroy the dog) and plenty of shop talk on writing, producing, and performing.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: Ice Nine Kills: I Heard They Kill Live 2
programme.desc: Watch I Heard They Kill Live 2, a live Ice Nine Kills concert film captured at Thanx-killing 2022 in Massachusetts.

programme.title: Metal From the Dirt: Rez Metal on the Navajo Nation
programme.desc: Navajo (Diné) musicians and scene builders trace the rise of Rez Metal, from generator-powered desert shows to Hogan rehearsals, blending heavy music with culture, pride, and survival.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Jon Foreman, frontman of the GRAMMY-winning rock band Switchfoot, joins Joel Madden for a thoughtful conversation on surfing, faith, creativity, and the balance between joy and discomfort. They explore themes of mindfulness, artistic purpose, and growth through challenge — diving into Jon’s new solo album In Bloom and the philosophies that guide both his music and his life.

programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: GHOST: Rite Here Rite Now - All Access Watch Party
programme.desc: GHOST’s debut film RITE HERE RITE NOW blends live performance with a narrative story. Filmed at Los Angeles' Kia Forum during the RE-IMPERATOUR tour finale.

programme.title: Fall Out Boy: So Much For (2our) Dust Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: Recorded at the iconic Madison Square Garden, So Much For (2our) Dust captures Fall Out Boy delivering an electrifying performance filled with emotion, energy, and nostalgia. With a setlist that spans their entire career — from early emo anthems to their latest hits — the band’s signature blend of heartfelt lyrics and explosive showmanship takes center stage. Between songs, frontman Pete Wentz shares raw reflections on loss, creativity, and the band’s improbable journey from punk clubs to arena stardom, making this concert a powerful chronicle of endurance and connection.

programme.title: Modest Mouse: Live From Red Rocks Amphitheatre
programme.desc: Modest Mouse performs live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre, showcasing songs from The Golden Casket in a special concert event.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Poppy starts to worry her whims might have consequences and brings in a scientist and a theologist to unpack chaos theory, the butterfly effect, and free will—while she processes the futility of it all. A game-show parody (“Lucky Case Game”) goes off the rails, the house band Rodent’s Revenge keeps the chaos moving, and Poppy “liberates” her beloved plants with the gift of free will. TV-14. Fictional violence and language.

programme.title: Benji & Joel Madden / Cameron Diaz & Katherine Power: Side Hustles
programme.desc: Good Charlotte’s Benji and Joel Madden share their journey into artist management, while Cameron Diaz and Katherine Power discuss building their organic wine brand, Avaline.

programme.title: Comedian CP: Sunday After Six
programme.desc: Known for his sharp wit and fearless storytelling, Comedian CP (Detroiters, Love Life, How to Die Alone) takes the stage in Sunday After Six — a no-holds-barred stand-up special that dives into fatherhood, relationships, race, and the kind of real-life moments you couldn’t make up. From awkward encounters to wild imagination, CP’s offbeat humor and unfiltered honesty make every punchline land harder than the last.

programme.title: First Listen: Motel Du Cap – Live with Good Charlotte
programme.desc: Hear Good Charlotte's new album in full with exclusive stories, commentary, and fan Q&A. Your front-row seat to Motel Du Cap.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: P!NK: The Truth About Love Tour - Live From Melbourne
programme.desc: P!NK performs a high-energy 2013 concert in Melbourne, featuring acrobatics, pyrotechnics, and hits like So What and Try.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum artist Darius Rucker joins Joel Madden to reflect on his journey from fronting Hootie & the Blowfish to becoming a country music icon. Rucker opens up about balancing family and touring, the band’s legacy, and the honesty that drives his songwriting. He also discusses breaking barriers in country music and his new memoir, Life’s Too Short, offering heartfelt insight into perseverance and authenticity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Dasha. Born in San Luis Obispo, California, Dasha started performing at ten and released her first song at thirteen. After years as an independent artist, her 2023 single "Austin (Boots Stop Workin')" went viral and landed her a deal with Warner Records. Since then, she's made her Grand Ole Opry debut, joined the Spotify Billions Club, and toured with Thomas Rhett and Luke Bryan.

programme.title: Nos Amis
programme.desc: Nos Amis follows Eagles of Death Metal members Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme as they recount their experiences before, during, and after the 2015 terrorist attack at the Bataclan Theatre in Paris. Blending intimate interviews, archival footage, and emotional reflection, the documentary explores trauma, friendship, and the unifying power of rock and roll.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Vishen Lakhiani, founder and CEO of Mindvalley, joins Joel Madden for an in-depth conversation on mindfulness, compassion, and redefining success. Together they explore meditation, conscious living, and how self-awareness and emotional intelligence can transform relationships, business, and personal growth.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: Jessi Cruickshank: Minivan Money
programme.desc: Comedian and TV host Jessi Cruickshank takes the stage in Toronto for her first stand-up special, Minivan Money. Known as “the funniest woman on television” (The Province), Cruickshank dives into the chaos of motherhood with biting honesty and fearless humor. From pumping breastmilk onstage to lusting after preschool dads, she turns the absurd realities of parenting into sharp, self-aware comedy. Blending storytelling, satire, and confessional wit, this live performance captures a comedian in full command of her craft — raw, real, and hilariously relatable.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Paul Weller on Wild Wood
programme.desc: Paul Weller reflects on creating Wild Wood and his early-’90s reinvention. The film explores his analog shift and key tracks “Wild Wood,” “Sunflower,” and “Moon on Your Pyjamas.”

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: De'Wayne discusses identity and growth with Joel, touching on Lenny Kravitz, arenas, and the garage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Mikaela Hoover discusses art and life on Artist Friendly, sharing personal insights and her pride in her wife's company, House of Harlow.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Backstreet Boys: Homecoming - Live In Orlando
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys returns to Orlando for a 1999 homecoming concert, performing hits like As Long As You Love Me and Everybody (Backstreet’s Back).

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: In the 1970's Hollywood began to release a whole new type of musical film. Bob Fosse, Hippies, and Jesus were the new stars in this adventurous period in cinema.

programme.title: Stiv: No Compromise No Regrets
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after Stiv's mysterious death in Paris, the Dead Boys have become the stuff of (Punk) legends but unsurprisingly, the story remains largely untold. How did this native from Girard, Ohio end up living the life of Riley in Paris, France' Was Stiv really hit by a car (or a taxi...) on that fateful day' Who was the real Stiv Bators' These are a few of the questions answered in STIV.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Etheridge discuss her message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: a-ha: The Movie
programme.desc: Take on Me made them global superstars. and a-ha still sells out arenas worldwide - but can they mend the broken friendships?

programme.title: B52s - Live At The US Festival
programme.desc: Watch the B-52's absolutely delight the crowd with Rock Lobster, Planet Claire, Private Idaho and more of their early classics. Live from the US Festival 1982

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Get Thrashed Around The World
programme.desc: Stellar metal bands came out of Germany, UK, France, Brazil, Canada, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Canada, and more as part of the Thrash Metal movement. Members of bands like Slayer, Metallica, Slipknot, and Exodus reminisce about their favorite bands and the best musicians of the era. A virtual encyclopedia of metal bands that toured the world, but that fans may have forgotten or can now discover.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell

programme.desc: String Theory: Guitar Obsessed delivers a humorous but reverent look at why we love the guitar. programme.title: Alternative Metal Paths
programme.desc: Break free from tradition with heavy riffs, crushing grooves, and genre-bending experiments. This collection showcases the boldest voices bridging alt-rock, grunge, and heavy metal into unvarnished, emotionally charged anthems.

programme.title: Finnish Metal Special
programme.desc: From the frozen North comes a sound of haunting melodies and raw intensity. Dive into Finland’s finest, where melancholic atmospheres meet the power of the thousand lakes. It’s a masterclass in darkness and ice-cold riffs.

programme.title: Folk Metal Forest Feast
programme.desc: Raise your horns and join the battle! A high-energy mix of crushing metal riffs, accordion melodies, and epic pagan chants. Step into the ancient woods for a wild night of acoustic tradition meets heavy metal fury.

programme.title: Your Pulse Of Metal
programme.desc: Sync your heartbeat to the complex rhythms of the underground. This collection dives into technical mastery and hidden gems that push your adrenaline. If you’re ready to feel the music in your veins, we’ve got the tracks.

programme.title: Manic Ritual
programme.desc: Lose yourself in the flickering shadows of distortion. A hypnotic sequence of sonic violence and dark imagery designed to unsettle the soul. Bow to the heavy. Welcome to the Manic Ritual.

programme.title: Thrash Metal Attack
programme.desc: Pure, unadulterated speed and fury! Experience blistering shred solos, aggressive riffing, and neck-snapping rhythms. Turn up the volume and brace yourself for an unstoppable wave of high-octane thrash metal chaos!

programme.title: The Home of Heavy
programme.desc: Step into the headquarters for everything that shakes the earth. From the pillars of the classics to the pioneers of the new era, this is where the heart of metal beats loudest. This is where you belong.

programme.title: Rock Bottom
programme.desc: Found your new baseline. Rock Bottom digs deep into the rawest hard rock and alt-anthems. We’re hitting the floor with heavy riffs and soulful grit—no shovels required, just volume. This is the foundation of everything that kicks.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Bach - Partita No. 2 and Sonata No. 3
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs two of J. S. Bach's incredible works for solo violin: Partita No. 2 in D minor (BWV 1004), and Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005).

programme.title: Edusei Conducts Mendelssohn, Schumann & Boulanger
programme.desc: In October 2020, German conductor Kevin John Edusei made his London Symphony Orchestra debut and led the orchestra in a performance of the suite from Mendelssohn's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" and more.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn & Hensel
programme.desc: A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev Conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

programme.title: The Babylon Hotel
programme.desc: Iconic music from movies and series such as "Babylon Berlin" and "The Great Gatsby."

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna from Vienna's Café Sperl; the ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Mineria.

programme.title: Beethoven Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: In this August 2020 concert at the Lucerne Festival, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich performs Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15 with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra; Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto & Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Violin Concerto in D minor, WoO 23, featuring Dutch violinist Isabelle van Keulen as the soloist; Symphony No. 1 in B-flat major, Op. 38. The concert recording is from Auditorium du Nouveau Siècle in Lille, France, on June 16, 2017.

programme.title: Descent Into the Maelstrom
programme.desc: In the 1980s, Philip Glass creates music for the Australian Dance Theatre based on "Descent into the Maelstrom" by Edgar Allan Poe.

programme.title: Works for Lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.

programme.title: Schubert -- Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D 944
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of "Symphony No. 9 in C Major, D. 944" by Franz Schubert.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Gershwin's Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Problemas de motor en el C-46 durante la carrera en valle obligan a Devan a apagar un motor.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto novato de bombas de agua, Scott, prueba por primera vez la acción cuando Buffalo responde a una llamada de emergencia.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando Yellowknife y la comunidad de aviación del norte se ven sacudidos por tres accidentes en el espacio de un mes...

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe recibe una visita negativa de Transport Canada cuando los inspectores amenazan con cerrar la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Abrumado por la responsabilidad de entrenar a un nuevo rampie y luchando por salir de la caseta del perro de Joe.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de tomar el mando de un puente aéreo intenso y lidiar con la carga de Electra más fea que jamás haya visto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una semana antes de Navidad, Buffalo acepta echar una mano a una iniciativa de la RCMP para llevar juguetes a comunidades aisladas del norte.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: A solo unos meses de jubilarse, el capitán de Electra, Ray Weber, dirige a su tripulación en una misión de varios viajes.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando los compradores surcoreanos vienen a Buffalo para ver un bombardero de agua.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo tiene que llevar un bombardero de agua CL-215 a los compradores de Corea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando llega la primavera y se acerca el día de la jubilación de Ray, Sean sorprende a todos al dejar Buffalo por un trabajo con la competencia.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El aeropuerto Narsarsuaq de Groenlandia, conocido como uno de los enfoques más peligrosos del mundo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey alquilan un helicóptero para una misión de rescate para recuperar el raro cordal de un Lockheed 10-A.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey se une con Chris Hadfield a bordo de la Estación Espacial Internacional.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe compite con una peculiar moto de nieve antigua, equipada con un motor de avión y sin frenos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una ola de frío provoca enormes desafíos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El Electra regresa de las reparaciones, y la tripulación lo lleva de vuelta a la pista de hielo de donde despegó antes del aterrizaje forzoso del año pasado.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Frente a la ira de Joe, Rod y Cory viajan al Reino Unido para realizar reparaciones urgentes en un avión cisterna de agua.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey se entrena para sobrevivir en el Alto Ártico con los Rangers Canadienses. La Fuerza Aérea invade el hangar de Chuck.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck y Brian observan cómo una unidad de energía de 5,000 libras cae al suelo, dañando el Electra y dejándolo fuera de servicio.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe y Mikey viajan a Inglaterra para traer un nuevo avión a casa.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El avión Electra de Buffalo enfrenta fuertes vientos en el valle del Mackenzie.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.desc: Dedicado a vida salvaje e historia natural de todo el mundo que te conecta y te acerca a nuestra planeta.

programme.title: Austria salvaje: la fuerza del agua
