programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: La Abominable Bestia De La Nieve
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y sus amigos organizan una jornada en la Montaña de Hielo para buscar la rara flor de la nieve para Papá Pitufo. Encuentran una terrorífica bestia de la nieve, pero acaban siendo amigos gracias a la amabilidad de Pitufina, y les ayuda a encontrar la minúscula flor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Perezoso sueña que está en la Isla Paraíso y libre de todo el trabajo que Papá Pitufo le impone. Su fantasía se vuelve una pesadilla que lo hace volver a trabajar nuevamente con afán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está horrorizado. Sasita no sabe leer, por lo que podría estar condenada a perderse las perlas de sabiduría que contiene su libro «Citas de Pitufo Filósofo». Así pues, intenta enseñarla a leer. Sin embargo, resulta que casi lo primero que puede leer es una fórmula para hacer que todos los libros desaparezcan. Todos los libros del mundo, ¡incluidos el libro de hechizos de Gargamel y los libros de remedios de Ómnibus!

programme.title: El Cuerno De La Abundancia
programme.desc: Madre Naturaleza siempre da lo mejor de sí misma, pero esta vez algo ha salido mal. Su varita no funciona según lo previsto y daña por accidente la cosecha otoñal. Ahora, los Pitufos y todos los animales del bosque se enfrentan a la escasez y el hambre de cara al invierno. El único lugar donde los Pitufos podrían obtener comida sería la Tierra de la Abundancia. Sin embargo, Gargamel roba el famoso Cuerno de la Abundancia para tender una trampa a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: La Pitufivisión De Genio
programme.desc: Pitufo Minero rebusca bajo todas las piedras y, gracias a ello, descubre un cristal que transmite imágenes. Esto permite a Pitufo Carpintero inventar la pitufivisión y, desde ese momento, los Pitufos pueden ver todas las mañanas los entrenamientos de Pitufo Fortachón, los informes de las cosechas de Pitufo Labrador e incluso el programa de Pitufo Filósofo. Pero ¿quién podría haberlo imaginado? ¡El malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la pitufivisión para atrapar Pitufos!

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: Narices Nuevas
programme.desc: A Pitufo Vanidoso no le gusta tener la misma nariz azul que el resto de los Pitufos. Necesita algo especial… Narizota, la prometida de Gigantón, también quiere cambiar su nariz. Y lo mismo le sucede a Gargamel. Así que se produce un intercambio de narices…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el Pitufo Filósofo pierde sus gafas deja caer las cosas, tropieza con los objetos, y se convierte en tan patoso como el Pitufo Tontín, que ahora tiene que leer a Filósofo y ayudarle a manejarse. Esta experiencia hace que Filósofo se sienta culpable por la forma en la que siempre se ha burlado de Tontín. Una vez que recibe un nuevo par de gafas, le trata con más respeto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos liberan a los Pitufos de las garras de Gargamel justo a tiempo para llevar a Bebé Pitufo a la ceremonia de su primera palabra. Bebé Pitufo pronuncia la palabra «Gargamel». Papá Pitufo afirma que esa palabra indica que Bebé Pitufo se convertirá un día en un gran líder, ya que significa que es consciente de los peligros de la vida.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Gigantón y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Gigantón está a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papá Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un monstruo del pantano secuestra a Bebé Pitufo como regalo para una bruja. La bruja, que cree que nadie la ama, se sorprende cuando Bebé Pitufo le demuestra afecto. Cuando Papá Pitufo acude a rescatar a Bebé Pitufo, consigue que la bruja entienda que el leal monstruo del pantano siempre la ha amado.

programme.title: ¡alarma, Pitufos!
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos se sienten poco queridos y deciden huir. Se llevan consigo objetos que les recuerden su hogar, lo que hace que los Pitufos crean que hay un ladrón entre ellos. Pitufo Filósofo intenta atrapar al ladrón instalando pitufialarmas. Las alarmas provocan un estruendo que atrae a los Pitufitos de vuelta a casa, donde Papá Pitufo les convence de que los quieren.

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Corazón De Oro
programme.desc: No importa lo que diga Pitufo Filósofo: Pitufo Robotín, la creación de Pitufo Carpintero, tiene sentimientos como cualquier Pitufo normal. O al menos eso parece… hasta que Pitufo Robotín pierde aquello que Pitufo Carpintero había colocado en su caja torácica: un corazón de oro. El malvado mago Gargamel y su aprendiz Escrupuloso encuentran al pequeño autómata y le colocan un corazón de piedra, lo que augura malos tiempos para los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la caja que ha encontrado Pitufo Bromista? Una capa que perteneció a Wislow, el gnomo mago. ¿Y de qué tipo de capa se trata? Pitufo Bromista descubre que es una capa de invisibilidad. Cualquiera que la lleve puesta tendrá una oportunidad fantástica para hacer bromas… e imagina el caos que puede crear Pitufo Bromista siendo invisible en la aldea. Pero si Wislow se desprendió de la capa, seguro que tenía sus motivos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Si hay algo que la malvada hechicera Clorhidris no puede soportar es la felicidad de las demás personas. Contemplar la vida de los Pitufos, llena de amabilidad y canciones, pone furiosa a Clorhidris. Debe destruir esas risas y ahogar esas felices conversaciones… Entonces, planta la raíz del mal en el bosque y, poco después, todos los Pitufos dejan de hablarse. El único que no se ha visto afectado es Bebé Pitufo…

programme.title: Cuidando A Pies Grandes
programme.desc: ¿Recuerdas al ogro Gigantón y a su encantadora esposa Narizota? Ahora tienen un bebé: el pequeño (según los estándares de los ogros) Pies Grandes. Como a los Pitufitos no les permiten cuidar de Bebé Pitufo, Pitufo Colérico, Pitufo Blandengue, Pitufo Natural y la siempre dispuesta Sasita se ofrecen a vigilar a Pies Grandes mientras sus padres están en el baile de los ogros. Los Pitufitos conseguirán más de lo que esperaban…

programme.title: Peligro En La Aldea
programme.desc: El pérfido mago Gargamel está harto de la constante superioridad de los Pitufos. Decide destruir su aldea de una vez por todas. Con ese fin, entrena una termita para que destroce, demuela, devaste y destruya todas las casas que se encuentre en su camino. Sin embargo, los efectos son mucho peores de lo que Gargamel había imaginado, ya que los Pitufos creen que las travesuras de los Pitufitos son las que están destruyendo su aldea.

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y está impresionado por la decoración de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a enseñarle el auténtico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad más hermosa que jamás hayan vivido…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Dilo Por Ti Mismo, Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador esconde su amor por Pitufina ocultándose en el anonimato y enviándole poemas. Cuando finalmente se encuentran, Gigantón les captura y, en sus esfuerzos por escapar, descubren su afecto mutuo.

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Amigos De Soñador
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Soñador decide visitar a sus amigos, los Tufos, Papá Pitufo crea una poción para transformar a los Pitufos en criaturas de aspecto alienígena. Sin embargo, los efectos de la poción desaparecen demasiado pronto y Pitufo Soñador tiene que enfrentarse a la realidad de que los Tufos no existen. Está triste hasta que llega un alienígena de verdad para devolver a Pitufo Soñador su carta, ya que la recibió por error.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para tratar de descubrir dónde se encuentra el escondite secreto de diamantes de los Pitufos, Gargamel finge ser su amigo. Cuando muestra su verdadera naturaleza malvada, Papá Pitufo conjura un hechizo mágico para salvar a sus pequeños Pitufos de las garras maliciosas del mago malvado.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a través de un río a un lugar desconocido. Allí conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabarán encontrándose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos navegan para salvar a Marco, que ha sido capturado por el Capitán Pedro Pimienta. Marina y un delfín acaban liberando a Marco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Armonía La Estrella De La Función
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía firma inconscientemente un contrato con Escritor Fantasma para escribir una sinfonía, lo que hace que quede atrapado en un club nocturno fantasmal para siempre. Papá Pitufo exige un juicio con un jurado y un juez de fantasmas, que declaran inocente a Pitufo Armonía y culpable de plagio a Escritor Fantasma.

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza más grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del revés y esto le convence de que no hay ningún sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel intenta probar un nuevo hechizo en los Pitufos, pero le sale al revés y se convierte a sí mismo en piedra. Los Pitufos están locos de alegría. ¡Su archienemigo ya no les hará sufrir nunca más!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pantano de Greenpeedeepee es el único lugar donde se pueden encontrar unas algas que son el delicioso e imprescindible ingrediente del famoso estofado de algas de Pitufo Goloso. Desafortunadamente, también es un lugar donde te puedes topar con los desagradables Verrugosos. A pesar de que Sasita y los Pitufos le salvan la vida a un joven Verrugoso, acaban siendo apresados por los demás. ¡Pero el Enmascarado Escarlata los salvará! Quizá…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: El Regreso De Don Pitufo
programme.desc: Cuando una gota de la nueva poción de Papá Pitufo cae en el libro de aventuras de los Pitufitos, el héroe de ficción cobra vida. El intrépido Don Pitufo, que desea deshacer a los Pitufos del malvado Gargamel, lo captura con valentía…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón aprende que las emociones pueden ser fantásticas, sobre todo después de que la malvada Clorhidris cree un corazón de hielo para despojar a todos de la bondad y el amor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz… ¡dándole un buen puntapié! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No todos los días se encuentra uno con una flor parlante. Y, en especial, con un personaje como Petaluma, una planta bulbosa algo arrogante con la que Pitufina se encuentra en el bosque. Por supuesto, Pitufina se muestra encantada y lleva a Petaluma con ella a la Aldea Pitufa… desencadenando un proceso que pondrá en peligro a todos los Pitufos. Parece que las flores están hechas para contemplarlas y no para escucharlas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A veces ocurren accidentes. ¡En esta ocasión, un error de Pitufo Bromista hace que su sombra cobre vida! Y a la sombra le encanta hacer bromas a todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa…

programme.title: Ya No Tengo Miedo
programme.desc: Una vez más, el infalible plan de Gargamel para atrapar a los Pitufos ha fracasado. Los Pitufos aprovechan para gastarle una broma: disfrazados de pequeños ángeles azules, le enseñarán a enmendar su conducta…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina guía a los Pitufos de caminata por la naturaleza, pero Puppy se adelantó demasiado y tras perseguirlo acaban en el territorio de los Wartmongers. El Rey de los Wartmongers acaba haciéndoles prisioneros en burbujas, pero un grupo de rebeldes les rescata y consiguen huir a lomos de Puppy.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deben encontrar a una familia de conejos para tirar de su carroza durante el Festival de Otoño. Gargamel ve la oportunidad de capturar a los pequeños seres azules y se disfraza de conejo gigante. ¿Conseguirá atrapar a todos los Pitufos de un plumazo?

programme.title: La Abominable Bestia De La Nieve
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y sus amigos organizan una jornada en la Montaña de Hielo para buscar la rara flor de la nieve para Papá Pitufo. Encuentran una terrorífica bestia de la nieve, pero acaban siendo amigos gracias a la amabilidad de Pitufina, y les ayuda a encontrar la minúscula flor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Perezoso sueña que está en la Isla Paraíso y libre de todo el trabajo que Papá Pitufo le impone. Su fantasía se vuelve una pesadilla que lo hace volver a trabajar nuevamente con afán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está horrorizado. Sasita no sabe leer, por lo que podría estar condenada a perderse las perlas de sabiduría que contiene su libro «Citas de Pitufo Filósofo». Así pues, intenta enseñarla a leer. Sin embargo, resulta que casi lo primero que puede leer es una fórmula para hacer que todos los libros desaparezcan. Todos los libros del mundo, ¡incluidos el libro de hechizos de Gargamel y los libros de remedios de Ómnibus!

programme.title: El Cuerno De La Abundancia
programme.desc: Madre Naturaleza siempre da lo mejor de sí misma, pero esta vez algo ha salido mal. Su varita no funciona según lo previsto y daña por accidente la cosecha otoñal. Ahora, los Pitufos y todos los animales del bosque se enfrentan a la escasez y el hambre de cara al invierno. El único lugar donde los Pitufos podrían obtener comida sería la Tierra de la Abundancia. Sin embargo, Gargamel roba el famoso Cuerno de la Abundancia para tender una trampa a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: La Pitufivisión De Genio
programme.desc: Pitufo Minero rebusca bajo todas las piedras y, gracias a ello, descubre un cristal que transmite imágenes. Esto permite a Pitufo Carpintero inventar la pitufivisión y, desde ese momento, los Pitufos pueden ver todas las mañanas los entrenamientos de Pitufo Fortachón, los informes de las cosechas de Pitufo Labrador e incluso el programa de Pitufo Filósofo. Pero ¿quién podría haberlo imaginado? ¡El malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la pitufivisión para atrapar Pitufos!

programme.title: A Todas Las Criaturas Grandes Y Pequeñas
programme.desc: Pitufo Natural está convencido de que puede ayudar a todas las criaturas con sus dones curativos, incluso al malvado Azrael, cuya pata queda atrapada en una trampa. El gato se cura y, a pesar de que tiene la tentación de quedarse con los Pitufos, regresa con Gargamel, pero conduce a su dueño hacia un lugar alejado de la Aldea Pitufa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una niña de seis años de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos niñas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel está decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convención de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su máquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazme reír de la Convención de los Magos.

programme.title: Narices Nuevas
programme.desc: A Pitufo Vanidoso no le gusta tener la misma nariz azul que el resto de los Pitufos. Necesita algo especial… Narizota, la prometida de Gigantón, también quiere cambiar su nariz. Y lo mismo le sucede a Gargamel. Así que se produce un intercambio de narices…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el Pitufo Filósofo pierde sus gafas deja caer las cosas, tropieza con los objetos, y se convierte en tan patoso como el Pitufo Tontín, que ahora tiene que leer a Filósofo y ayudarle a manejarse. Esta experiencia hace que Filósofo se sienta culpable por la forma en la que siempre se ha burlado de Tontín. Una vez que recibe un nuevo par de gafas, le trata con más respeto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos liberan a los Pitufos de las garras de Gargamel justo a tiempo para llevar a Bebé Pitufo a la ceremonia de su primera palabra. Bebé Pitufo pronuncia la palabra «Gargamel». Papá Pitufo afirma que esa palabra indica que Bebé Pitufo se convertirá un día en un gran líder, ya que significa que es consciente de los peligros de la vida.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Que Suerte Tan Torpe
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la superstición cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el lejano Valle de Nodrog, los Pitufos se encuentran con El Molians, que quiere conseguir la Pitufo-Piedra que Papá Pitufo necesita para curar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Gigantón y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Gigantón está a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papá Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: Jewish Gis
programme.desc: Jewish GIs of WWII tells the profound and unique story of the 550,000 Jewish men and women who served in World War II. Held as POWs and awarded honours for merit and valour, thousands were wounded and 11,000 were killed in action. Ten thousand Jewish women joined up as well, disregarding their parents' warnings that the military 'was no life for a nice Jewish girl'. In the midst of it all, they fought a second, more private battle against anti-Semitism within the ranks. They endured slurs and even violence from their fellow servicemen, and often felt forced to prove their courage and patriotism. Jewish Americans earned their citizenship by shedding blood, leaving their outsider status behind.

programme.desc: What would you do if you had a sneaking suspicion that your partner was unfaithful, but you couldn’t prove it? Elizabeth and Shawn say they’re at the breaking point in their marriage because Elizabeth thinks her husband is cheating on her. Shawn says he has nothing to hide, and the biggest issue in their relationship is Elizabeth’s lack of trust. Recently, Elizabeth received a phone call in the middle of the night from a man who accused Shawn of sleeping with his wife. How does Shawn respond? Then, the accused husband says he’s willing to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Find out what happens when Dr. Phil offers to provide the test backstage. Will Elizabeth’s fears be allayed, or does she have a reason to be skeptical of her spouse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cheating, lying and sexual misconduct. Although public figures from John Edwards to Tiger Woods have admitted to this behavior, how would you handle accusations of infidelity in your own relationship? Tingle says she can’t trust her husband, Hermann. She says he lied about how many times he’d been married, and when she discovered he was registered on a singles dating site, he told her that he was doing research for a friend! She says she’s also suspicious of her spouse’s low sex drive and fears he may be getting his needs met elsewhere. Hermann says he wants to regain his wife’s trust but says he can’t handle her insecurity. Should Tingle give him another chance or kick him to the curb? And, when Elizabeth was last on the show, she wanted to know once and for all if her husband, Shawn, was being unfaithful. Find out why Shawn initially agreed to take a polygraph test but later declined. Can this relationship be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort, a young man who was abducted by a family friend when he was 11 years old, reunites two decades later with the FBI agent that he says saved his life. Go inside the dramatic rescue of Tony from a convicted sex offender. Plus, Alicia Kozak says she was just 13 when she was lured from her home by an internet predator and placed in a dog collar, chained to the floor, and horrifically abused. Hear her inspiring story of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

But Wanda says Tiffany is making up lies about her and she knows why; Wanda claims it’s payback for Wanda having an affair and abandoning the family when Tiffany was just 14 years old. Wanda says her bipolar disorder is at fault for her earlier actions. Tiffany says she is sick of her mother blaming her mental health issues for her bad behavior. Tiffany says if Dr. Phil can’t fix this, then her mother is out of her life for good. Can Dr. Phil get this mother-daughter duo to see eye to eye for the first time?

Rheta says she's so fed up with their mother-and-son bond that she's filed for divorce, shredded her wedding vows and has even come to blows with Deb on several occasions. Mark agrees that his mother is too involved, but can he break ties while Deb holds the purse strings? Does paying the couple's rent and providing them with a car give Deb license to criticize Rheta and try to set Mark up with other women? Rheta says that on some days, she and Mark are best friends, but their arguments get so heated that they've turned physical -- in front of their three children. Will a grand gesture from Mark keep Rheta from walking away? Can Rheta and Deb mend fences?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This Dr. Phil Family is angry, out of control, and about to get an intervention in The Dr. Phil House. Melissa, 22, wrote to Dr. Phil for help for her self-destructive family. Her mother, Myra, and her stepfather, Gene, have a long history of betrayals, infidelity, anger and years of bitter resentment. Melissa says her family even turns special occasions into volatile disasters with turkey dinners and Christmas trees being thrown across the room. The fighting got so bad, Melissa says she had to move away from her extreme family. Her brothers, Edwin, 20, and Eugene, 17, attest that their home is a war zone, and that they have witnessed fights between their parents that involve name-calling, spitting and dousing each other with water, all in front of their 7-year-old brother. Myra says she can’t forgive Gene for his four affairs, but especially the last one, which was with a 19-year-old. Over three years have passed since Gene’s last affair, but Myra still calls him a pedophile every chance she gets, and says she’d leave if it weren’t for their youngest child. Can this family learn to stop the drama, heal their anger and start over with a healthy foundation, or should they call it quits for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she is worried that her 38-year-old brother-in-law Kevin may be having an inappropriate relationship with her 16-year-old daughter, Grace. Bridget says red flags went up when Grace told her that Kevin put whipped cream on his neck and asked her to lick it off, and then found a letter from Kevin hidden in Grace’s bedroom. Kevin strongly denies having an inappropriate relationship with Grace, and claims he’s just trying to be a father figure since Grace’s dad passed away. But is there something more?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bridget says she’s not sure what to believe about the relationship between her 38-year-old brother-in-law, Kevin, and 16-year-old daughter, Grace.Dr. Phil says Bridget is a parent in denial and in need of a wake-up call. He sits down one-on-one with Kevin. How does Kevin explain his actions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with The Dr. Phil Family, an out-of-control, angry group with a long history of infidelities, betrayals and bitter resentments. Melissa’s boyfriend, Randy, joins the family at The Dr. Phil House, but Gene and Myra are not happy to see him. They think that Randy is a liar and a thief, and the reason Melissa has gained about 100 pounds in the last five years. Gene and Myra attempt to talk to Melissa about her weight, but Melissa is anything but receptive. Then, because they often blame each other for the chaos in the family, Melissa and Gene are assigned to bury the hatchet long enough to cook a family dinner together, without help from anyone else. Will these relatives be able to follow the rules? After dinner, a family meeting turns heated with accusations and tearful confessions. Dr. Phil joins the family and confronts Melissa and Randy about their sometimes violent relationship and Melissa’s mismanagement of her health. Can this couple create a nurturing relationship for the sake of their autistic child? Will Melissa do what it takes to gain control over her weight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After all their hard work, the latest Dr. Phil Family receives some surprises from Dr. Phil! He informs Melissa that everything she needs to get her life back on track is headed her way: a complete health evaluation, personal trainer, nutritionist, and food service delivered to her door. In addition, she’ll receive help for her depression and be connected with a developmental disabilities specialist for her autistic son. But it all comes with a condition: Melissa and Randy need to heal their toxic relationship. Then, a talk with Myra and Gene leads to a tearful apology. And, will a one-on-one with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin, help Myra see that she deserves to be treated with dignity and respect? Will Myra set some standards in her broken marriage? Will there even be a marriage to speak of when they get home? Dr. Phil has some strong words for Gene. Next, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity pits brother against brother as Edwin and Eugene audition for a Hollywood talent agent and a casting director. Don’t miss the surprising twist when they get a call from the judges. Then, it’s time to switch gears – literally! Since Myra and Melissa never learned to drive, Dr. Phil sets them up with a driving lesson so they can become more independent. And you won’t believe the prize in store for the women if they pass their driver’s test! Dr. Phil sits down with the entire family one last time. Will they use the tools he gave them to build healthier relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Recently, parents across America were googling “Who is Andrew Tate?” making him number three in Google searches for 2022, right behind Queen Elizabeth and Donald Trump. Tate claims to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. However, in August 2022, Tate was banned on social media for his misogynist viewpoints. Twenty-four-year-old Ben says when he was a teen, he had zero self-esteem, never got past the first date, and felt powerless with girls. He tells Dr. Phil that men like Tate inspired him to break out of his shell -- and he shares how. Then, a healthy debate about “toxic masculinity” with the “Godfather of the Manosphere," a scholar and author, a men’s rights attorney, and the CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andrew Tate is known for his misogynistic social media posts and videos claiming to be helping young men acquire lots of money, drive luxury cars, and pick up hot women. Tate is fighting a legal battle in Romania right now, but should parents worry about his influence on their sons? Before Tate was detained, Dr. Phil spoke with Richard Reeves, senior fellow at the Brookings Institute and author “Of Boys and Men: Why the Modern Male is Struggling, Why it Matters, and What to Do about It”; Marilyn York, a men’s rights attorney; Imran Ahmed, CEO and founder of the Center for Countering Digital Hate; and blogger and author Rollo Tomassi. Plus, hear from a group of teenage boys who surprise their mothers when they share what they think about Tate. And, Robin joins the conversation.

programme.title: Dr. Phil Primetime
programme.desc: Dr. Phil joins NYC Mayor Eric Adams on an evening tour of Herald Square and West 4th Street subway stations to explore the PATH initiative, which offers resources to help homeless and mentally ill individuals transition off the streets.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nicky, 17, says she loves to fight and proudly posts the videos of the brawls on the Internet. The teen brags that she once cracked a girl’s head on the concrete, has broken cheekbones and noses, and has had so many confrontations, she's lost count. She says the police have been called to her home as many as 80 times, and she’s been arrested monthly since she was 13 years old. What’s at the root of her rage? Dr. Phil delves deep into Nicky’s past to find the source of her pain. And, Nicky’s mom, Yvette, says she feels helpless and fears her daughter will end up dead or in prison, but is she modeling bad behavior? An anonymous letter to the show makes shocking allegations against Yvette. Can Dr. Phil get this family help -- before someone gets really hurt -- or worse?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: From the Forest National in Brussels, Belgium on October 6, 2012. This event featured a super fight between Remy Bonjasky and Anderson Silva as headliner, Also this event featured non-tournament super fight series.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Headlining GLORY 110 is a contest for the vacant GLORY featherweight world championship as Portuguese sensation Miguel Trindade takes on Belgian ‘Bad Boy’ Deniz Demirkapu.

programme.desc: A string of murders on local neighborhood sex workers have been occurring around one specific apartment building’s laundry room. But all suspicion points to the newly hired attendant, Calvin who was just released from prison for 12 years.

programme.title: Trouble
programme.desc: As Draven faces financial ruin and a serious illness, her marriage to Adam frays. She reconnects with Ceceilius, a wealthy ex, finding comfort in his stability. But as their romance blossoms, Adam’s jealousy spirals into a dangerous obsession, fueled by terrifying dreams and a mysterious woman, Robin. With a wedding on the horizon and secrets unraveling, love and betrayal collide, leading to a shocking conclusion where nothing is as it seems.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Widower Syndrome
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal car accident a year ago, Xavier and his wife Amanda, take their daughter on a road trip hoping for a family reset. After a pit stop, Amanda and Alexandria disappear, and everyone is convinced he came to the park alone. A race of desperation to find the truth, may also reveal Xavier’s own sanity.

programme.title: More Than Friends
programme.desc: When Angela, a heterosexual, learns her friend, Tennille, loves her, she is surprised to find that she may feel the same.

programme.title: 3 Way Poly
programme.desc: A young couple's experiment in intimacy spirals into a nightmare when they invite a seductive stranger into their home. Little do they know, she's a killer on the loose, and their lives hang by a thread

programme.title: Three Secrets
programme.desc: Struck with the grief after losing her child, Naomi is stuck in a depression while her husband begins to stray from their marriage. Hoping to bring life back into their boring marriage, he invites her to go out with him and they meet a mysterious woman who joins them for the evening. As events unfold She finds herself in an unexpected entanglement built on lies.

programme.title: Trapped in the Game
programme.desc: Polo is a young desperate hustler looking to make some quick cash. However, the only way he knows how to make cash quickly, is pimping out young women with the help of his crew. When of his crew starts taking girls off the street, the heat threatens to bring down his whole operation.

programme.title: My Man
programme.desc: Trina, a young model, becomes entangled with the charming Max. As their relationship deepens, she uncovers his dark secrets: a double life, a psychotic ex-girlfriend, and a dangerous obsession. When Trina crosses a line, she becomes the target of a deadly game of cat and mouse. Betrayal, madness, and murder ensue as the lines between love, obsession, and survival blur.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: Contusion
programme.desc: Terry and his grandmother enjoy a life of peace and harmony, until one night when a group of thieves invade their home. As he navigates from the aftermath, he must confront whether justice will prevail or whether darkness will consume everything he holds dear.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate

programme.title: Giant Cat 5090B Front Shovel Excavator Loading Gravel On Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s stunning ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, capturing the raw power and precision of the Caterpillar 5090B Front Shovel Excavator. This giant machine is seen loading gravel from a deposit area onto a fleet of 4-axle Mercedes and MAN trucks, preparing materials for ongoing operations across the mine.

programme.title: Extreme 4K Highway Construction Full Of Heavy Equipment In Action!
programme.desc: In today’s construction video, we are on a huge highway construction site, packed with Caterpillar and Liebherr excavators, a Cat motor grader, a bulldozer, and a fleet of 4-axle trucks—all working together in a fast-moving, high-productivity operation.

programme.title: Liebherr 984 & Cat 395 Loading Overburden Onto 4 Axle Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s coal mining video, we are inside a huge open-pit coal mine, watching two giants work side by side—the Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator and the Caterpillar 395—loading overburden onto Mercedes and MAN 4-axle trucks with incredible speed and precision.

programme.title: Terex RH30F Excavator XR80 With Xcentric Vibro Ripper & Cat 385C Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s mining video, we’re working inside a huge open-pit mine, watching an operation that combines advanced rock-breaking technology with classic heavy excavation power.

programme.title: Caterpillar 385C Excavator Loading Coal Onto 4 Axle Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s mining video, we are inside a huge coal mining site, watching the powerful Caterpillar 385C hydraulic excavator loading coal onto a continuous flow of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: 3 Excavators Loading Overburden + Cat 160H Grader in Huge Mine
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we’re at the heart of a massive open-pit mining operation, where three powerful excavators and a Caterpillar 160H grader are working together with amazing precision and coordination to move overburden and prepare the site for the next phase of production.

programme.title: Relocating The Caterpillar D9T Dozer, Liebherr 974 & Liebherr 954
programme.desc: In today’s heavy haul video, we follow a full relocation operation, transporting three massive machines from one job site to the next nearby project using a heavy-duty trailer and a MAN TGX 530 special transport truck.

programme.title: Mining Site Full Of Caterpillar & Liebherr Excavators And Fleet Of Trucks
programme.desc: In today’s video, we are inside a busy coal mining site, watching a non-stop operation where multiple excavators load coal and overburden onto a fleet of 4-axle trucks.

programme.title: Caterpillar 992K Wheel Loader Loading Cat 777F Dumpers With Aggregates
programme.desc: In today’s video, we’re inside a huge aggregate quarry, watching an impressive, high-production operation where a Caterpillar 992K wheel loader loads blasted material onto Caterpillar 777F dumpers with speed, precision, and nonstop rhythm.

programme.title: Komatsu D475 Bulldozer With Engine Failure Hauled To Service
programme.desc: After suffering a major engine failure, the Komatsu D475 had to be transported immediately to the service unit. Time was critical and the transport team acted fast, loading this giant machine onto a heavy-duty trailer and making their way through the mine's rugged terrain.

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator
programme.desc: In today’s incredible ground footage, we follow the full behind-the-scenes process of preparing, loading, and transporting one of the largest excavators in the mine — the mighty Liebherr 984 hydraulic excavator.

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones
programme.desc: In today’s ground footage, we are deep inside a massive mining operation, watching a powerful lineup of three heavy-duty excavators working in perfect coordination to break and load extremely hard stone layers. - Leading the operation is the Caterpillar 385C excavator, equipped with a heavy bucket, responsible for loading broken debris onto Caterpillar dumpers. Supporting this are the: - Terex RH30F fitted with a vibro ripper, used to tear through tough rock layers - Liebherr 954 outfitted with a hydraulic breaker, smashing dense stone into manageable pieces - This combo of ripping, hammering, and loading shows how professional operators and the right equipment can handle even the hardest terrain.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: Bring a clear intention to your practice today, looking inward to ask: How would I like to take a stand in the world? Qigong offers a safe, supportive way to place your attention on the intention of being lit by the light of the sun. That is, moving in the world with clear direction, lightness, and heart-led purpose.

programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades
programme.desc: This practice is a culmination and celebration of all you’ve learned in this class, allowing you the opportunity to practice all eight Silk Brocades and experience the emotional, mental, physical, and spiritual benefits of qigong.

programme.desc: Night 2 of Lost Evenings VI in Anaheim finds Frank Turner & The Sleeping Souls tearing through favorites and deep cuts from the first four albums—Sleep Is for the Week, Love Ire & Song, Poetry of the Deed, and England Keep My Bones. A charged, communal set featuring sing-alongs like “Try This at Home,” “Reasons Not to Be an Idiot,” “Nashville Tennessee,” “Peggy Sang the Blues,” “There Is No God,” and “If Ever I Stray/Keep Having Dreams,” captured live at House of Blues Anaheim.
